_note: Rules documentation. HemodynamicService uses equivalent constants (top of the class). Any change here must be mirrored in HemodynamicService.java AND in the LocalEngine of api.js.

abi.caveat: ABI is validated for peripheral arterial disease; here it is a distal perfusion signal (project adaptation)

pulse_pressure.note: red if absolute (<25 mmHg) OR proportional (<25% of systolic)

informational_only.calf_circumference_cm: validated, but not used in any rule (the frontend sends 35.0 + variation)

provisional_rules.head_neck: jugular DILATED + ABI<=0.90 = RED; jugular only = YELLOW; ABI<=0.90 only = YELLOW (downgrades from green)

orthostatic_alert.status: DEMO HEURISTIC - no validated clinical basis
